dict.string: HushKey captures system audio only when you explicitly start a meeting using System audio or Both sides. Audio is streamed to on-device speech recognition and is not saved.
HushKey listens only when you start local dictation, meeting notes, or an experiment recording.
HushKey reads processed head motion from compatible headphones for local silent-mouthing experiments.
HushKey recognizes speech on this Mac only when on-device recognition is available.
